FULL TEXT:
REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.-14/R&A Dated: 30th March, 2026
All candidates of the Regular Mazdoor Recruitment Examination, 2025, notified under
Advertisement No. PHC/01/2025, are hereby informed that the scores and relevant remarks of
the following stages have been made available on the website of the Court:
• Written Test held on 22nd June, 2025
• Cycling Test held from 10th to 12th December, 2025
• Skill Test held from 23rd to 29th December, 2025 (except 25th December)
• Interview held from 2nd to 11th February, 2026 (except 8th February)
Candidates may view their scores and remarks by clicking on the link provided on the
Court’s website, using the login credentials issued to them at the time of registration.
The candidates must take notice that the link shall remain active till 30th April, 2026
only. Accordingly, candidates are hereby advised to retain their score for any future reference or
requirement.
Besides, in light of Clause 12(xxx) of the above-referred advertisement, no application
under RTI Act, 2005 seeking information relating to scores and cut-off marks of the Regular
Mazdoor Recruitment Examination, 2025, shall be entertained.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
